scenes.description: the resuscitation bay of a busy Indian hospital emergency department: an empty trolley bed with a folded sheet, a patient monitor on a stand, oxygen and suction points on the wall, a curtain on a ceiling rail, a red crash cart
an adult intensive care unit bay: an empty ICU bed with a monitor, a ventilator on a stand, an IV pole, a glass partition to the next bay, soft dim lighting
a paediatric intensive care bay: a small hospital cot with raised side rails, a monitor, a soft toy on a chair, gentle animal decals on the pale wall
a general hospital ward: a row of beds separated by curtains, bedside lockers, a tall window, a ceiling fan
an outpatient consultation room: a doctor's desk with a computer monitor, two chairs facing it, an examination couch behind a half-drawn curtain, a wall chart with no readable text

an empty relatives' room in an Indian hospital: a simple two-seat sofa and an armchair, a low table with a box of tissues and a jug of water, a window with half-closed blinds and soft daylight, a small potted plant, a plain wall clock, pale walls
a hospital waiting area: rows of connected metal seats, a reception counter in the distance, a water cooler, a token display screen with no readable text
a hospital corridor: doors along both sides, wall handrails, an empty stretcher parked against one wall, a bench
